sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: An investigative report by METR revealed that Anthropic is using artificial intelligence to build better systems at twice the speed seen last year. Employees reported massive productivity boosts when using these internal tools. Although Anthropic gave researchers broad access, the company heavily redacted the final public document to protect commercial secrets and prevent rivals from copying its methods.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The findings challenge previous timelines regarding how soon artificial intelligence might improve itself without human help. Critics highlighted a contradiction between the company calling for caution in the industry while simultaneously speeding up its own research. Furthermore, the extensive redactions sparked concern that the public lacks sufficient information to assess the risks properly.

sections.heading: What happens next
